content: Task completion chatbots (TCC), or task-oriented chatbots, are dialogue agents used to fulfill specific purposes, such as helping customers book airline tickets, or a government inquiry system. Examples include the AIML based chatbot BIBREF5 and DIVA Framework BIBREF6. While TCC are low cost, easily configurable, and readily available, they are restricted to working well for particular domains and tasks.
